'''Charger's Irregulars''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit founded and commanded by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Charger (Human)|Charger]]. A small group of fifteen [[Human/Legends|Human]] mercenaries, Charger's Irregulars specialized in small conflicts such as brushfire wars and combat hot spots. The unit operated throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], willing to fight for anyone willing to pay their fee, expenses, and hazard bonuses.<ref name="PSG" />
